verification: Mocked: fixture-local sessions and in-memory session feed in CI; no live swarm transcripts.
assertions: Tool call volume of 4000 or one million never merges sessions in different worktrees; a time-window merge in one worktree is labelled quarantined whatever its tool count.
A quarantined merge writes no sibling edges.
A replacement naming a session of another task stays in its own task and counts as a cross_thread conflict.
A replacement naming a session in another project is not linked and counts as a cross_project conflict.
Malformed lineage refuses the whole feed batch and leaves committed state absent.
group_sessions does not mutate its input.
